### Top Nonprofit CRMs with Integrated Donation Forms

Several nonprofit CRMs from the search results stand out for combining donor management with built-in online donation forms. These tools streamline fundraising by automating data flow from forms directly into donor records, enabling tracking, acknowledgments, and segmentation. Here's a breakdown of the strongest matches, prioritized by explicit mentions of donation forms and key features:

| CRM | Key Features | Best For | Integrations Noted |
|-----|--------------|----------|-------------------|
| **DonorPerfect** ([1]) | Online forms for donations, recurring gifts, tributes; auto-syncs to donor records; 3x higher completion rates; mass mailing, moves management. | Mid-sized nonprofits needing robust admin automation. | Grant/gift tracking. |
| **Funraise** ([2]) | Custom online donation forms; donor profiles, engagement tracking, email marketing; campaign management; high-performing forms. | Small nonprofits prioritizing ease and affordability. | Seamless tech tool integrations; distinguishes CRM from pure fundraising platforms. |
| **Givebutter** ([3], [10]) | Full fundraising suite with donation forms (47% conversion); donor management, engagement tracking, personalized comms. | All sizes; flexible, modern all-in-one platform. | Double the Donation for matching gifts. |
| **CauseVox** ([6]) | Customizable, mobile-friendly donation pages; auto-syncs donor data; peer-to-peer; donor self-service portal. | Small teams focused on donor journeys and simplicity. | Built-in CRM syncs with campaigns. |
| **Donorbox** ([7]) | All-in-one with AI-powered CRM; donate buttons, online forms; email management, segmentation. | Broad fundraising needs with AI efficiency. | Comprehensive donor tools. |
| **Bloomerang** ([8]) | Fundraising CRM with donor/volunteer management; implies form integration for acquisition. | Donor retention and volunteer coordination. | Not specified in results. |
| **Keela (via Aplos)** ([9]) | Donation management with CRM; tracks engagement. | Team collaboration and donation increases. | Aplos integration. |

#### Why These Fit "Nonprofit CRM with Donation Forms"
- **Core Match**: All emphasize donor CRMs (centralized databases for relationships, tracking) paired with forms that handle online giving, recurring donations, and data automation—avoiding manual entry.
- **Standouts**:
  - **Funraise** and **Givebutter** excel for small orgs with user-friendly forms and analytics.
  - **DonorPerfect** leads for scale, with proven form performance.
  - Many integrate with matching gift tools (e.g., Double the Donation [3]) to boost revenue by screening donors post-donation.
- **CRM vs. Fundraising Platforms**: Results ([2], [6]) clarify CRMs focus on long-term donor relations (profiles, segmentation, lifecycle tracking), while forms add immediate fundraising—ideal for unified workflows.

For implementation, start with free trials (e.g., DonorPerfect, Funraise). Match to your size: Funraise/Givebutter for small budgets; DonorPerfect for complex needs. If matching gifts matter, prioritize Givebutter, Funraise, or DonorPerfect.
